entities.summary: Andrzej Bogdan Cofalik is a weightlifter from Poland. He won the Bronze medal in the 83 kg in the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta. Andrzej Cofalik was a athletes & competitors from Palowice (b. 1968-09-08, Palowice). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
